text: the men that were at peace: Heb. the men of thy peace | they that eat thy bread: Heb. the men of thy bread | in: Or, of it
carry away captive: Or, carried away his substance
thou shouldest not have looked: Or, do not behold, etc. | spoken proudly: Heb. magnified thy mouth
deliverance: Or, they that escape | shall be holiness: Or, it shall be holy
which is in Sepharad: Or, shall possess that which is in Sepharad
